pages.title: Spacetime Alloy Singularity
pages.text: Spacetime alloy crushed into a single point, its woven space and time folded inward. Distances near it seem shorter than they should, and time seems to skip. It feels slightly warped. A ruler laid beside it reads a slightly different length every time.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Spacetime alloy is metal woven with spacetime. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor, I folded its spacetime inward into a single point.
